jobs.description:
We are currently looking for an experienced Senior .NET Architect to lead the architecture, modernization, and technical governance of a portfolio of business-critical enterprise applications.

This role is ideal for a hands-on technical leader who enjoys shaping architecture strategy, mentoring development teams, and driving large-scale modernization initiatives using modern Microsoft technologies.
Key responsibilities

• Lead the architecture of multiple application domains and enterprise solutions

• Define target-state architecture and modernization roadmaps

• Guide development teams on architecture decisions and complex technical challenges

• Lead migrations from legacy .NET Framework applications to modern .NET platforms

• Drive cloud-native and containerization initiatives

• Architect scalable MicroServices and distributed systems solutions

• Provide architectural guidance for Blazor applications

• Mentor and coach Full Stack .NET development teams

• Facilitate architecture reviews, design workshops, and technical governance activities

• Collaborate closely with Product Owners, developers, and business stakeholders

Nice to have

• Kubernetes (K8s)

• Cloud-Native Architecture

• Containerization Strategies

• Dapr

• NServiceBus

• Hangfire

• Distributed Systems Architecture

• Experience within Energy, Utilities, or Infrastructure sectors

What we're looking for

You are a strategic yet hands-on architect with a passion for building scalable, maintainable, and modern software solutions. You can influence technical direction, mentor engineering teams, and successfully drive modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.

📩 Interested? Feel free to reach out or share your updated CV for a confidential discussion.

• Minimum 4 years of experience as a .NET Architect

• Strong expertise in:

• 

• C#

• .NET (Modern .NET & Legacy .NET Framework)

• Blazor

• SQL Server

• MongoDB

• RabbitMQ

• strong knowledge of

• Clean Architecture

• Software Architecture Design

• Technical Leadership

• experience with

• MicroServices Architecture

• Enterprise Application Modernization

• Leading Development Teams

• Technical Governance

• Cross-Team Technical Delivery

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Professional English skills

• Dutch or French language proficiency

Onze klant is een dynamische, internationale KMO met een familiaal karakter. Ze hebben een hart voor interieurdecoratie en industriële kunststoftoepassingen.

Jobomschrijving

As the backbone of our export team, you create happy customers by offering a hassle-free service from A to Z. You report to the team lead and work together with the sales director, other customer care officers and sales managers.

• You manage the whole ordering process of a specific customer portfolio, from quotation to shipment, including customs procedures. You are responsible for the correct follow-up of pricing and conditions.  You also work on the credit and collection cycle.
• As the backbone of the company, you find the balance between customer care and organizational possibilities. For that, you work in close contact with colleagues from other departments such as supply chain and finance.
• We take customer engagement to the next level by following up on lead generation and by translating our global marketing plan to country-specific initiatives.
• You handle complaints and give the full customer experience while doing so.
• As a product expert, you provide advice and answers to technical or inspirational questions.
• You create real ‘wow’-moments along the customer journey of your client. We provide several tools for you to use, but your commercial feeling will help you make the right decision.
• Obviously, you are in very close contact with your sales colleagues. They support you and vice versa.

• You understand what a top-notch customer experience is about. You love to deliver results above customer expectations. Your mature nature and great communicative skills help you in this challenge.
• Your problem-solving skills in combination with your optimism make you a perfect customer-care enthusiast.
• You have a hands-on personality. You are not afraid to take on challenges outside of your daily job.
• You have a master’s or bachelor’s degree.
• You have a good English command and you speak at least one other language (German, Spanish, Italian,…)
• Knowledge of SAP and customs is a big plus, but no deal breaker. We love to teach you all about it.
• You live in the near vicinity of our Ostend office.

We are currently looking for a Receptionist for a temporary replacement to join a lovely international company located near Avenue Louise in Brussels.
 

As the first point of contact for visitors and colleagues, you will play an important role in ensuring a warm welcome and the smooth day-to-day running of the office. You will work in a pleasant, professional and English-speaking environment.
 

Your responsibilities
 

Welcome visitors and ensure a professional and friendly reception.
 

Answer incoming calls and handle general enquiries.
 

Manage incoming and outgoing mail and deliveries.
 

Coordinate meeting rooms and assist with appointments.
 

Provide general administrative support to the team.
 

Help maintain an organised and welcoming office environment.

You have previous experience in reception, front-office or administrative support.
 

You are fluent in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an asset.
 

You have excellent communication and organisational skills.
 

You are service-oriented, proactive and flexible.
 

You are comfortable working in an international environment and handling several tasks simultaneously.
 

You are available for a temporary replacement.

For our client, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE.The company specializes in both small and large renovation projects throughout West Flanders. They handle full A-to-Z renovations as well as smaller works such as bathroom renovations, mainly for private clients, with occasional assignments for companies and organizations.

As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, your tasks include:
• Assisting with paving, small renovations, and indoor works
• Preparing renovation works (measuring, basic demolition, preparing materials)
• Installing plasterboard (gyproc), small masonry tasks, and simple carpentry
• Assisting with floor and tile installation and basic interior finishing
• Supporting full renovation projects from A to Z
• Preparing materials, assisting with installation, finishing, and site cleanup
As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, you recognize yourself in the following:

• You have initial experience as a renovation worker
• You speak Dutch or English
• You are not afraid of physical work

For our client in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a motivated GROUNDWORKER.

Our client is a highly driven company with 125 years of experience, specialized in earthworks and the installation of pipelines and landscaping for cities and municipalities.

As a CONSTRUCTION WORKER in the VEURNE region, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

• Sewer installation works
• Installing curbstones and edging
• Construction of cycle paths, roads, and parking areas
• Laying environmental pavement solutions
• Installation of roundabouts and traffic islands
• Laying paving stones and sidewalk tiles
• Small to large-scale earthworks
 

As a GROUNDWORKER in the VEURNE region, you can identify yourself in the following profile:

• You speak Dutch, English, or French fluently;
• You have relevant experience in road construction;
• You hold a valid driving licence B (additional licences are a plus);
• You are able to travel to the company independently (not accessible by public transport);
• You are practical, hands-on, and enjoy working outdoors.

Looking for a varied role in the logistics sector?Would you like to join an international working environment?Then SD Worx Jobs has the perfect opportunity for you! 

For a growing logistics company in the Willebroek region, SD Worx Jobs is looking for a Warehouse Operator.

Your responsibilitiesµ

No two days are the same! As a key player in the logistics process, you help ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

• Receive incoming goods and place them in the correct warehouse locations.

• Pick and pack online orders for shipment.

• Perform quality checks to ensure high service standards.

• Monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner.

• You speak and understand English.

• Previous experience in logistics is preferred.
